title: Data skew, broadcast joins and repartitioning

videos.script: One visitor in this data set has nine hundred and sixty thousand events. The median visitor has twelve. {{crawler}} Join the events to the visitors, and the shuffle sends every row of a key to the same task. One task reads a million rows. The other hundred and ninety-nine read about a hundred and twenty thousand each. {{skew}} This lesson finds that task, and then tries the cures. Broadcast the small side, and there is no shuffle to be uneven. Salt the hot key, and it is split by hand. Or let adaptive execution split it for you. {{cures}} You will time all of them, and on this lab none of them beats doing nothing, which is a lesson too. {{honest}} Then the other end of a job: how many files it writes, and why one of them wrote fifteen hundred. {{files}}
